pictures.name: NM1-Ruined-City
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich hand-woven textiles, deep blue shadows and warm gold lamplight, soft painterly brushwork, main subject in the middle of the frame. No text, no letters, no logos, no modern objects. Jerusalem after its fall: broken stone walls and toppled columns on a hill, smoke drifting from distant ruins of a great temple, empty streets, a few scattered pottery shards. No people, no bodies. Grey-blue dusk sky, last embers glowing faintly. Grief and silence.

pictures.name: NM2-The-Poet
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich hand-woven textiles, deep blue shadows and warm gold lamplight, soft painterly brushwork, main subject in the middle of the frame. No text, no letters, no logos, no modern objects. Among the ruins of Jerusalem at evening, the poet, a man in a torn, ash-grey robe and dark mantle, shown ONLY from behind, his face never visible, sits on a fallen stone with a writing board on his knees, head bowed, the broken city spread out before him. A single small oil lamp beside him. Deep mourning.

pictures.name: NM3-Long-Night
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich hand-woven textiles, deep blue shadows and warm gold lamplight, soft painterly brushwork, main subject in the middle of the frame. No text, no letters, no logos, no modern objects. Night over the empty ruined city of Jerusalem, a deep blue sky with cold stars, wind blowing dust through an empty square, a lone widow in a dark shawl sitting by a broken gateway with her head in her hands. Loneliness: the city that was full of people now empty. Quiet sorrow, not graphic.

No text, no letters, no logos, no modern objects. The first light of dawn breaking over the hills behind the ruined walls of Jerusalem, a thin line of gold on the horizon. the poet, a man in a torn, ash-grey robe and dark mantle, shown ONLY from behind, his face never visible, still sitting on the fallen stone, has lifted his head toward the light, his back to the viewer. Hope stirring in the dark.

pictures.name: NM5-New-Morning
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich hand-woven textiles, deep blue shadows and warm gold lamplight, soft painterly brushwork, main subject in the middle of the frame. No text, no letters, no logos, no modern objects. Full sunrise over the ruins of Jerusalem, warm gold light pouring across the broken stones, a few green shoots and small white flowers growing between them, dew sparkling, birds rising into the sky. The ruins are the same, but bathed in light. Mercy, faithfulness, a new morning.

pictures.name: NM6-Today
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows and warm gold lamplight, soft painterly brushwork, main subject in the middle of the frame. A modern setting painted in the same contemplative oil style, warm light, no readable text, no logos. A modern bedroom at early morning. A person sits on the edge of the bed in pajamas, phone face-down on the nightstand, looking toward a window as the first sunlight streams in, hands resting open on their knees, a gentle smile. A new morning.
